item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 06/Feb/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, the weather will be cold over inland Guangdong today and tomorrow. A broad band of clouds will bring rainy weather to the coast of southern China midweek this week. An intense replenishment of the monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China on Wednesday night. It will become cold over the region in the following couple of days. Under the influence of a relatively dry continental airstream, there will be sunny periods over the coast of southern China during the Lunar New Year holidays. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.

Date/Month: 06/02 (Tuesday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few light rain patches. Slightly cooler in the morning and at night.
Temp range: 17 - 20 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low

PSR: Medium Low
